column8: ["All three seats read as deep tilted cups, with visible inner walls and off-centre wells; flatten them into concentric, straight-down openings.","The seat rims have directional bright edges and heavy opposing shadows; use symmetric shading that will hold when the sprite rotates.","Dark mottling muddies the red seat’s glaze and both teal rims; keep the state colours clean and confine wear to contact edges.","The connecting links read as flat brown straps rather than rubbed brass; give the continuous fork a clearer brass surface under even light."]
